description: Fetch the build state and result URL for a presentationId.

keptVersion.description: Set when the latest republish failed (publishStatus failed) and the presentation still plays this earlier version at webUrl.

narration.description: Narration progress: status (complete | partial | failed | waiting | …) and per-slide errors when partial/failed. waiting = the rest of the audio is still coming; the slides are viewable and it lands without another call.

ready.description: True once the presentation is viewable.
